verses.ar: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ ﴿۱﴾
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
Ya Sin.[✛]

verses.ar: وَالۡقُرۡاٰنِ الۡحَکِیۡمِ ۙ﴿۳﴾
verses.en: By the Qur’an, full of wisdom,

verses.ar: اِنَّکَ لَمِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِیۡنَ ۙ﴿۴﴾
verses.en: Thou art indeed one of the Messengers,

verses.ar: عَلٰی صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِیۡمٍ ؕ﴿۵﴾
verses.en: On a right path.

verses.ar: تَنۡزِیۡلَ الۡعَزِیۡزِ الرَّحِیۡمِ ۙ﴿۶﴾
verses.en: This is a revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful,

verses.ar: لِتُنۡذِرَ قَوۡمًا مَّاۤ اُنۡذِرَ اٰبَآؤُہُمۡ فَہُمۡ غٰفِلُوۡنَ ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: That thou mayest warn a people whose fathers were not warned, and so they are heedless.

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلٰۤی اَکۡثَرِہِمۡ فَہُمۡ لَا یُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: Surely the word has proved true against most of them, for they believe not.

verses.ar: اِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِیۡۤ اَعۡنَاقِہِمۡ اَغۡلٰلًا فَہِیَ اِلَی الۡاَذۡقَانِ فَہُمۡ مُّقۡمَحُوۡنَ ﴿۹﴾
verses.en: [✲]We have put round their necks, chains reaching unto the chins, so that their heads are forced up.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡۢ بَیۡنِ اَیۡدِیۡہِمۡ سَدًّا وَّمِنۡ خَلۡفِہِمۡ سَدًّا فَاَغۡشَیۡنٰہُمۡ فَہُمۡ لَا یُبۡصِرُوۡنَ ﴿۱۰﴾
verses.en: And We have set a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, and have covered them over, so that they cannot see.

verses.ar: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَیۡہِمۡ ءَاَنۡذَرۡتَہُمۡ اَمۡ لَمۡ تُنۡذِرۡہُمۡ لَا یُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ ﴿۱۱﴾
verses.en: And it is equal to them whether thou warn them or warn them not: they will not believe.

verses.ar: اِنَّمَا تُنۡذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّکۡرَ وَخَشِیَ الرَّحۡمٰنَ بِالۡغَیۡبِ ۚ فَبَشِّرۡہُ بِمَغۡفِرَۃٍ وَّاَجۡرٍ کَرِیۡمٍ ﴿۱۲﴾
verses.en: Thou canst warn only him who would follow the Reminder and fear the Gracious God in secret. So give him the glad tidings of forgiveness and a noble reward.
w: so give him the glad tidings

verses.ar: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡیِ الۡمَوۡتٰی وَنَکۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوۡا وَاٰثَارَہُمۡ ؕؑ وَکُلَّ شَیۡءٍ اَحۡصَیۡنٰہُ فِیۡۤ اِمَامٍ مُّبِیۡنٍ ﴿٪۱۳﴾
verses.en: Surely, We alone give life to the dead, and We record that which they send forward and that which they leave behind; and all things have We recorded in a clear Book.
w: and that which they leave behind

verses.ar: وَاضۡرِبۡ لَہُمۡ مَّثَلًا اَصۡحٰبَ الۡقَرۡیَۃِ ۘ اِذۡ جَآءَہَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۱۴﴾
verses.en: And set forth to them the parable of a people of the town, when the Messengers came to it.

verses.ar: اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَاۤ اِلَیۡہِمُ اثۡنَیۡنِ فَکَذَّبُوۡہُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوۡۤا اِنَّاۤ اِلَیۡکُمۡ مُّرۡسَلُوۡنَ ﴿۱۵﴾
verses.en: When We sent to them two Messengers, and they rejected them both; so We strengthened them by a third, and they said, ‘Verily we have been sent to you as Messengers.’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا مَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَا ۙ وَمَاۤ اَنۡزَلَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مِنۡ شَیۡءٍ ۙ اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا تَکۡذِبُوۡنَ ﴿۱۶﴾
verses.en: They replied, ‘You are but men like us and the Gracious God has not revealed anything. You only lie.’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا رَبُّنَا یَعۡلَمُ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیۡکُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ ﴿۱۷﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘Our Lord knows that we are indeed His Messengers to you;

verses.ar: وَمَا عَلَیۡنَاۤ اِلَّا الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِیۡنُ ﴿۱۸﴾
verses.en: ‘And on us lies only the plain delivery of the Message.’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡۤا اِنَّا تَطَیَّرۡنَا بِکُمۡ ۚ لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَہُوۡا لَنَرۡجُمَنَّکُمۡ وَلَیَمَسَّنَّکُمۡ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِیۡمٌ ﴿۱۹﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘Surely we augur evil fortune from you; if you desist not, we will certainly stone you, and a painful punishment will surely befall you at our hands.’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا طَآئِرُکُمۡ مَّعَکُمۡ ؕ اَئِنۡ ذُکِّرۡتُمۡ ؕ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ مُّسۡرِفُوۡنَ ﴿۲۰﴾
verses.en: They replied, ‘Your evil fortune is with your own selves. Is it because you have been admonished? Nay, you are a people transgressing all bounds.’

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ اَقۡصَا الۡمَدِیۡنَۃِ رَجُلٌ یَّسۡعٰی قَالَ یٰقَوۡمِ اتَّبِعُوا الۡمُرۡسَلِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۲۱﴾
verses.en: And from the farthest part of the town there came a man running. He said, ‘O my people, follow the Messengers,

verses.ar: اتَّبِعُوۡا مَنۡ لَّا یَسۡـَٔلُکُمۡ اَجۡرًا وَّہُمۡ مُّہۡتَدُوۡنَ ﴿۲۲﴾
verses.en: ‘Follow those who ask of you no reward, and who are rightly guided.

verses.ar: وَمَا لِیَ لَاۤ اَعۡبُدُ الَّذِیۡ فَطَرَنِیۡ وَاِلَیۡہِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ ﴿۲۳﴾
verses.en: ‘And what reason have I that I should not worship Him Who has created me, and unto Whom you will be brought back?

verses.ar: ءَاَتَّخِذُ مِنۡ دُوۡنِہٖۤ اٰلِہَۃً اِنۡ یُّرِدۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّیۡ شَفَاعَتُہُمۡ شَیۡئًا وَّلَا یُنۡقِذُوۡنِ ﴿ۚ۲۴﴾
verses.en: ‘Shall I take others beside Him as gods? If the Gracious God should intend me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they rescue me.

verses.ar: اِنِّیۡۤ اِذًا لَّفِیۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِیۡنٍ ﴿۲۵﴾
verses.en: ‘In that case I should indeed be in manifest error.

verses.ar: اِنِّیۡۤ اٰمَنۡتُ بِرَبِّکُمۡ فَاسۡمَعُوۡنِ ﴿ؕ۲۶﴾
verses.en: ‘I believe in your Lord; so listen to me.’

verses.ar: قِیۡلَ ادۡخُلِ الۡجَنَّۃَ ؕ قَالَ یٰلَیۡتَ قَوۡمِیۡ یَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۲۷﴾
verses.en: It was said to him, ‘Enter Paradise.’ He said, ‘O, would that my people knew,

verses.ar: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِیۡ رَبِّیۡ وَجَعَلَنِیۡ مِنَ الۡمُکۡرَمِیۡنَ ﴿۲۸﴾
verses.en: ‘How graciously my Lord has granted me forgiveness and has made me of the honoured ones!’

verses.ar: وَمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلٰی قَوۡمِہٖ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِہٖ مِنۡ جُنۡدٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَمَا کُنَّا مُنۡزِلِیۡنَ ﴿۲۹﴾
verses.en: And We sent not down against his people, after him, any host from heaven, nor did We need to send down any.

verses.ar: اِنۡ کَانَتۡ اِلَّا صَیۡحَۃً وَّاحِدَۃً فَاِذَا ہُمۡ خٰمِدُوۡنَ ﴿۳۰﴾
verses.en: It was but a single blast and lo! they were extinct.

verses.ar: یٰحَسۡرَۃً عَلَی الۡعِبَادِ ۚؑ مَا یَاۡتِیۡہِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا کَانُوۡا بِہٖ یَسۡتَہۡزِءُوۡنَ ﴿۳۱﴾
verses.en: [✲]Alas for My servants! there comes not a Messenger to them but they mock at him.

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ یَرَوۡا کَمۡ اَہۡلَکۡنَا قَبۡلَہُمۡ مِّنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ اَنَّہُمۡ اِلَیۡہِمۡ لَا یَرۡجِعُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۳۲﴾
verses.en: Have they not seen how many generations We have destroyed before them, and that they never return to them?

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ کُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِیۡعٌ لَّدَیۡنَا مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ ﴿٪۳۳﴾
verses.en: And all of them, gathered together, will certainly be brought before Us.

verses.ar: وَاٰیَۃٌ لَّہُمُ الۡاَرۡضُ الۡمَیۡتَۃُ ۚۖ اَحۡیَیۡنٰہَا وَاَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡہَا حَبًّا فَمِنۡہُ یَاۡکُلُوۡنَ ﴿۳۴﴾
verses.en: And the dead earth is a Sign for them: We quicken it and bring forth therefrom grain, of which they eat.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِیۡہَا جَنّٰتٍ مِّنۡ نَّخِیۡلٍ وَّاَعۡنَابٍ وَّفَجَّرۡنَا فِیۡہَا مِنَ الۡعُیُوۡنِ ﴿ۙ۳۵﴾
verses.en: And We have placed in it gardens of date-palms and grapes, and We have caused springs to gush forth therein,
w: and We have caused to gush forth

verses.ar: لِیَاۡکُلُوۡا مِنۡ ثَمَرِہٖ ۙ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡہُ اَیۡدِیۡہِمۡ ؕ اَفَلَا یَشۡکُرُوۡنَ ﴿۳۶﴾
verses.en: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and it was not their hands that made them. Will they not then be grateful?

verses.ar: سُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِیۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَزۡوَاجَ کُلَّہَا مِمَّا تُنۡۢبِتُ الۡاَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ اَنۡفُسِہِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا یَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ﴿۳۷﴾
verses.en: Holy is He Who created all things in pairs, of what the earth grows, and of themselves, and of what they know not.

verses.ar: وَاٰیَۃٌ لَّہُمُ الَّیۡلُ ۚۖ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡہُ النَّہَارَ فَاِذَا ہُمۡ مُّظۡلِمُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۳۸﴾
verses.en: [✲]And a Sign for them is the night from which We strip off the day, and lo! they are in darkness.

verses.ar: وَالشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِیۡ لِمُسۡتَقَرٍّ لَّہَا ؕ ذٰلِکَ تَقۡدِیۡرُ الۡعَزِیۡزِ الۡعَلِیۡمِ ﴿ؕ۳۹﴾
verses.en: [✲]And the sun is moving on the course prescribed for it. That is the decree of the Almighty, the All-Knowing God.

verses.ar: وَالۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنٰہُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰی عَادَ کَالۡعُرۡجُوۡنِ الۡقَدِیۡمِ ﴿۴۰﴾
verses.en: And for the moon We have appointed stages, till it becomes again like an old dry branch of a palm-tree.
w: like dry branch of a palm-tree

verses.ar: لَا الشَّمۡسُ یَنۡۢبَغِیۡ لَہَاۤ اَنۡ تُدۡرِکَ الۡقَمَرَ وَلَا الَّیۡلُ سَابِقُ النَّہَارِ ؕ وَکُلٌّ فِیۡ فَلَکٍ یَّسۡبَحُوۡنَ ﴿۴۱﴾
verses.en: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor can the night outstrip the day. All of them float in an orbit.

verses.ar: وَاٰیَۃٌ لَّہُمۡ اَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّیَّتَہُمۡ فِی الۡفُلۡکِ الۡمَشۡحُوۡنِ ﴿ۙ۴۲﴾
verses.en: And a Sign for them is that We carry their offspring in the laden ship,

verses.ar: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَہُمۡ مِّنۡ مِّثۡلِہٖ مَا یَرۡکَبُوۡنَ ﴿۴۳﴾
verses.en: [✲]And We have created for them the like thereof whereon they ride.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ نَّشَاۡ نُغۡرِقۡہُمۡ فَلَا صَرِیۡخَ لَہُمۡ وَلَا ہُمۡ یُنۡقَذُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۴۴﴾
verses.en: And if We so willed, We could drown them; then they would have no one to succour them, nor would they be rescued,

verses.ar: اِلَّا رَحۡمَۃً مِّنَّا وَمَتَاعًا اِلٰی حِیۡنٍ ﴿۴۵﴾
verses.en: Except through mercy from Us and as a provision for a time.

verses.ar: وَاِذَا قِیۡلَ لَہُمُ اتَّقُوۡا مَا بَیۡنَ اَیۡدِیۡکُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَکُمۡ لَعَلَّکُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَ ﴿۴۶﴾
verses.en: And when it is said to them, ‘Guard yourselves against that which is before you and that which is behind you, in order that you may receive mercy,’ they turn away.

verses.ar: وَمَا تَاۡتِیۡہِمۡ مِّنۡ اٰیَۃٍ مِّنۡ اٰیٰتِ رَبِّہِمۡ اِلَّا کَانُوۡا عَنۡہَا مُعۡرِضِیۡنَ ﴿۴۷﴾
verses.en: And there comes not to them any Sign out of the Signs of their Lord, but they turn away from it.

verses.ar: وَاِذَا قِیۡلَ لَہُمۡ اَنۡفِقُوۡا مِمَّا رَزَقَکُمُ اللّٰہُ ۙ قَالَ الَّذِیۡنَ کَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡۤا اَنُطۡعِمُ مَنۡ لَّوۡ یَشَآءُ اللّٰہُ اَطۡعَمَہٗۤ ٭ۖ اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا فِیۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِیۡنٍ ﴿۴۸﴾
verses.en: And when it is said to them, ‘Spend out of that with which Allah has provided you,’ those who disbelieve say to those who believe, ‘Shall we feed him whom Allah would have fed, if He had so willed? You are but in manifest error.’

verses.ar: وَیَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰی ہٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ کُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِیۡنَ ﴿۴۹﴾
verses.en: And they say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if indeed you are truthful?’

verses.ar: مَا یَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا صَیۡحَۃً وَّاحِدَۃً تَاۡخُذُہُمۡ وَہُمۡ یَخِصِّمُوۡنَ ﴿۵۰﴾
verses.en: They are waiting only for a single blast which will seize them while they are disputing.

verses.ar: فَلَا یَسۡتَطِیۡعُوۡنَ تَوۡصِیَۃً وَّلَاۤ اِلٰۤی اَہۡلِہِمۡ یَرۡجِعُوۡنَ ﴿٪۵۱﴾
verses.en: And they will not be able to make a will, nor will they return to their families.

verses.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِی الصُّوۡرِ فَاِذَا ہُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَجۡدَاثِ اِلٰی رَبِّہِمۡ یَنۡسِلُوۡنَ ﴿۵۲﴾
verses.en: And the trumpet shall be blown, and lo! from the graves they will hasten on to their Lord.

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا یٰوَیۡلَنَا مَنۡۢ بَعَثَنَا مِنۡ مَّرۡقَدِنَا ٜؐۘ ہٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَصَدَقَ الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ ﴿۵۳﴾
verses.en: They will say, ‘O! woe to us! who has raised us up from our place of sleep? This is what the Gracious God had promised, and the Messengers spoke the truth.’

verses.ar: اِنۡ کَانَتۡ اِلَّا صَیۡحَۃً وَّاحِدَۃً فَاِذَا ہُمۡ جَمِیۡعٌ لَّدَیۡنَا مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ ﴿۵۴﴾
verses.en: It will be but one blast and lo! they will all be brought before Us.

verses.ar: فَالۡیَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٌ شَیۡئًا وَّلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا کُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ ﴿۵۵﴾
verses.en: And on that day, no soul will be wronged in aught; nor will you be rewarded but for what you used to do.

verses.ar: اِنَّ اَصۡحٰبَ الۡجَنَّۃِ الۡیَوۡمَ فِیۡ شُغُلٍ فٰکِہُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۵۶﴾
verses.en: [✲]Verily the inmates of Heaven will, on that day, be happy in their occupation.

verses.ar: ہُمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجُہُمۡ فِیۡ ظِلٰلٍ عَلَی الۡاَرَآئِکِ مُتَّکِـُٔوۡنَ ﴿۵۷﴾
verses.en: They and their wives will be in pleasant shades, reclining on raised couches.

verses.ar: لَہُمۡ فِیۡہَا فَاکِہَۃٌ وَّلَہُمۡ مَّا یَدَّعُوۡنَ ﴿ۚۖ۵۸﴾
verses.en: They will have fruits therein, and they will have whatever they call for.
‘Peace on you’ — a word of greeting from the Merciful Lord.

verses.ar: وَامۡتَازُوا الۡیَوۡمَ اَیُّہَا الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ ﴿۶۰﴾
verses.en: And God will say, ‘Separate yourselves from the righteous this day, O ye guilty ones!
w: and God will say, Separate yourselves from the righteous

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ اَعۡہَدۡ اِلَیۡکُمۡ یٰبَنِیۡۤ اٰدَمَ اَنۡ لَّا تَعۡبُدُوا الشَّیۡطٰنَ ۚ اِنَّہٗ لَکُمۡ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِیۡنٌ ﴿ۙ۶۱﴾
verses.en: ‘Did I not enjoin on you, O ye sons of Adam, that you worship not  Satan — for he is to you an open enemy —

verses.ar: وَّاَنِ اعۡبُدُوۡنِیۡ ؕؔ ہٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِیۡمٌ ﴿۶۲﴾
verses.en: ‘And that you worship Me? This is the right path.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَضَلَّ مِنۡکُمۡ جِبِلًّا کَثِیۡرًا ؕ اَفَلَمۡ تَکُوۡنُوۡا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ ﴿۶۳﴾
verses.en: ‘And he did lead astray a great multitude of you. Why did you not then understand?

verses.ar: ہٰذِہٖ جَہَنَّمُ الَّتِیۡ کُنۡتُمۡ تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ ﴿۶۴﴾
verses.en: ‘This is the Hell which you were promised.

verses.ar: اِصۡلَوۡہَا الۡیَوۡمَ بِمَا کُنۡتُمۡ تَکۡفُرُوۡنَ ﴿۶۵﴾
verses.en: ‘Enter it this day, because you disbelieved.’

verses.ar: اَلۡیَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلٰۤی اَفۡوَاہِہِمۡ وَتُکَلِّمُنَاۤ اَیۡدِیۡہِمۡ وَتَشۡہَدُ اَرۡجُلُہُمۡ بِمَا کَانُوۡا یَکۡسِبُوۡنَ ﴿۶۶﴾
verses.en: This day We shall put a seal on their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will bear witness to what they had earned.

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسۡنَا عَلٰۤی اَعۡیُنِہِمۡ فَاسۡتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَاَنّٰی یُبۡصِرُوۡنَ ﴿۶۷﴾
verses.en: And if We had so willed, We could have put out their eyes, then they would have rushed to find the way. But how could they see?

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنٰہُمۡ عَلٰی مَکَانَتِہِمۡ فَمَا اسۡتَطَاعُوۡا مُضِیًّا وَّلَا یَرۡجِعُوۡنَ ﴿٪۶۸﴾
verses.en: And if We had so willed, We could have transformed them so as to transfix them in their places, then they would not be able to move forward or turn back.

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ نُّعَمِّرۡہُ نُنَکِّسۡہُ فِی الۡخَلۡقِ ؕ اَفَلَا یَعۡقِلُوۡنَ ﴿۶۹﴾
verses.en: [✲]And him whom We grant long life — We revert him to a weak condition of creation. Will they not then understand?
w: We revert him to a weak condition of

verses.ar: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنٰہُ الشِّعۡرَ وَمَا یَنۡۢبَغِیۡ لَہٗ ؕ اِنۡ ہُوَ اِلَّا ذِکۡرٌ وَّقُرۡاٰنٌ مُّبِیۡنٌ ﴿ۙ۷۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]And We have not taught him poetry, nor does that suit it (the Qur’an). It is but a Reminder and a Qur’an that makes things plain,

verses.ar: لِّیُنۡذِرَ مَنۡ کَانَ حَیًّا وَّیَحِقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلَی الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ ﴿۷۱﴾
verses.en: [✲]So that it may warn all who live, and that the word of punishment be justified against the disbelievers.

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ یَرَوۡا اَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَہُمۡ مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ اَیۡدِیۡنَاۤ اَنۡعَامًا فَہُمۡ لَہَا مٰلِکُوۡنَ ﴿۷۲﴾
verses.en: Do they not see that, among the things which Our hands have fashioned, We have created for them cattle of which they are masters?

verses.ar: وَذَلَّلۡنٰہَا لَہُمۡ فَمِنۡہَا رَکُوۡبُہُمۡ وَمِنۡہَا یَاۡکُلُوۡنَ ﴿۷۳﴾
verses.en: And We have subjected the same to them, so that some of them they use for riding and some others they eat.
w: and We have subjected the same

verses.ar: وَلَہُمۡ فِیۡہَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ؕ اَفَلَا یَشۡکُرُوۡنَ ﴿۷۴﴾
verses.en: And in them they have other benefits and also drinks. Will they not then be grateful?

verses.ar: وَاتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰہِ اٰلِہَۃً لَّعَلَّہُمۡ یُنۡصَرُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۷۵﴾
verses.en: And they have taken other gods beside Allah, that they might be helped.

verses.ar: لَا یَسۡتَطِیۡعُوۡنَ نَصۡرَہُمۡ ۙ وَہُمۡ لَہُمۡ جُنۡدٌ مُّحۡضَرُوۡنَ ﴿۷۶﴾
verses.en: [✲]They are not able to help them, but they will be brought before God as their allied host.

verses.ar: فَلَا یَحۡزُنۡکَ قَوۡلُہُمۡ ۘ اِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا یُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا یُعۡلِنُوۡنَ ﴿۷۷﴾
verses.en: So let not their speech grieve thee. Verily We know what they conceal and what they proclaim.

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ یَرَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقۡنٰہُ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَۃٍ فَاِذَا ہُوَ خَصِیۡمٌ مُّبِیۡنٌ ﴿۷۸﴾
verses.en: Does not man see that We have created him from a mere spermdrop? Yet lo! he is an open quarreller!

verses.ar: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَّنَسِیَ خَلۡقَہٗ ؕ قَالَ مَنۡ یُّحۡیِ الۡعِظَامَ وَہِیَ رَمِیۡمٌ ﴿۷۹﴾
verses.en: And he coins similitudes for Us and forgets his own creation. He says, ‘Who can quicken the bones when they are decayed?’

verses.ar: قُلۡ یُحۡیِیۡہَا الَّذِیۡۤ اَنۡشَاَہَاۤ اَوَّلَ مَرَّۃٍ ؕ وَہُوَ بِکُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِیۡمُ ﴿ۙ۸۰﴾
verses.en: Say, ‘He, Who created them the first time, will quicken them; and He knows every kind of creation full well,

verses.ar: ۣالَّذِیۡ جَعَلَ لَکُمۡ مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الۡاَخۡضَرِ نَارًا فَاِذَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ مِّنۡہُ تُوۡقِدُوۡنَ ﴿۸۱﴾
verses.en: ‘He Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, and behold, you kindle from it.

verses.ar: اَوَلَیۡسَ الَّذِیۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰۤی اَنۡ یَّخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَہُمۡ ؕ؃ بَلٰی ٭ وَہُوَ الۡخَلّٰقُ الۡعَلِیۡمُ ﴿۸۲﴾
verses.en: ‘Has not He Who created the heavens and the earth the power to create the like of them?’ Yea, and He is indeed the Supreme Creator, the All-Knowing.

verses.ar: اِنَّمَاۤ اَمۡرُہٗۤ اِذَاۤ اَرَادَ شَیۡئًا اَنۡ یَّقُوۡلَ لَہٗ کُنۡ فَیَکُوۡنُ ﴿۸۳﴾
verses.en: [✲]Verily His command, when He intends a thing, is only that He says to it, ‘Be!,’ and it is.

verses.ar: فَسُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِیۡ بِیَدِہٖ مَلَکُوۡتُ کُلِّ شَیۡءٍ وَّاِلَیۡہِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ ﴿٪۸۴﴾
verses.en: So Holy is He, in Whose hand is the kingdom of all things. And to Him will you all be brought back.
